articles.title: A week of AI coding cut a quantum-safe bitcoin transaction estimate from $320 to $66
articles.snippet: StarkWare, which conducted the research, says contest participants using AI tools made the computation about five times faster, though the $66 figure has not yet been demonstrated in another transaction mined on Bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin price steadies, ONDO rallies as US Treasury yields hit 2007 highs
articles.snippet: US Treasury yields hit a 19-year high on Thursday, pressuring risk assets as Bitcoin held near $84,000 and ONDO became top performer among altcoins.

articles.title: Australia says OpenAI agent hacked government site before Altman warning
articles.snippet: OpenAI notified Australia nearly three months after its agent breached a government portal while gathering public medicine-spending data.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.snippet: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: Bitcoin Breakout Cools as Fed Rate-Hike Bets Climb
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has slipped back below $85,000 after tagging an eight-month high near $87,400 last week, with rising odds of an October Fed hike taking some air out of the rally.
